Interpretation of when Phase III confirmation procedures are required versus optional changes which TRE monitoring steps were actually applicable.

candidates.exact_span: conduct chemical specific analyses when a probable toxicant has been identified
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether a probable toxicant has been identified determines if chemical-specific monitoring was required; different readings affect obligation applicability (B) and whether absent chemical results reflect conditional non-requirement versus missing required evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: Where the permittee has identified or suspects specific pollutant(s) and/or source(s) of effluent toxicity, the permittee shall conduct, concurrent with toxicity testing, chemical specific analyses for the identified and/or suspected pollutant(s) and/or source(s) of effluent toxicity.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The threshold for 'identified or suspects' governs which pollutant/source-specific analyses were mandatory; this changes which parameters enter limit-comparison evaluation (A), which monitoring was required (B), and how missing chemical data should be classified (C).

candidates.exact_span: Where toxicity was demonstrated within 24 hours of test initiation, each composite sample shall be analyzed independently. Otherwise the permittee may substitute a composite sample, comprised of equal portions of the individual composite samples, for the chemical specific analysis
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether toxicity was demonstrated within 24 hours switches between mandatory independent composite analysis and permissive pooled composite analysis; different interpretations change applicable monitoring requirements (B) and whether absent or pooled results satisfy or leave gaps in evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall initiate the TRE Action Plan within thirty (30) days of plan and schedule submittal.
candidates.computation_change_reason: What event counts as 'plan and schedule submittal' and when the 30-day initiation clock starts affects whether TRE initiation was a timely required obligation during FY2025.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall submit a quarterly TRE Activities Report to the EPA WET Coordinator (6WQ-PO) in the months of January, April, July and October
candidates.computation_change_reason: The specified reporting months define recurring monitoring/reporting obligations for FY2025 (B); interpretation of whether a given quarter's report was due and what its absence means affects missing-evidence classification (C).
